card.text: Ultra-hot giant planet where iron vapour condenses on the night side.

sources.label: Ehrenreich et al. 2020
sources.quote: Iron must thus condense during its journey across the nightside.

introduction.text: WASP-76b circles its star every 43 hours. Iron vapour seen at its evening edge is gone at its morning edge: iron condenses on the night side.

sources.label: Ehrenreich et al. 2020
sources.quote: no signal arises from the nightside close to the morning terminator, showing that atomic iron is not absorbing starlight there

temperature.title: Spitzer heat map
temperature.summary: Heat at 4.5 µm from the paper's own map fit: a simple day-night pattern. A spot at midnight shows no data.
